d: Company Description Perdi Jewellery is a luxury jewellery brand in Qatar, known for its elegant diamond collections and sophisticated designs. Since 2015, the company has built a strong reputation as a preferred destination for customers seeking premium diamond jewellery and exceptional service. Each piece is meticulously crafted to reflect timeless style, quality, and attention to detail. Perdi Jewellery offers a refined shopping experience where a passion for perfection and aesthetic excellence is central to the brand. The company continues to grow its loyal clientele through a commitment to luxury, authenticity, and customer satisfaction.

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Sales Executive role based in Doha, Qatar. The Sales Executive will welcome and engage customers, present jewellery collections, explain product features, and guide clients through selection and purchase decisions. Responsibilities include achieving sales targets, handling customer inquiries, preparing quotations, and processing transactions accurately. The role also involves maintaining visual merchandising standards, ensuring product displays are appealing, and keeping the showroom organized. The Sales Executive will build long-term customer relationships, follow up on leads, support promotional activities, and collaborate with the team to optimize the overall customer experience.
q: Strong sales and customer service skills, including consultative selling and relationship building.
Experience in retail or luxury goods, ideally in jewellery, fashion, or related high-end products.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact confidently with diverse customers.
Attention to detail and product presentation skills, including basic visual merchandising and showroom upkeep.
Basic numeracy and transactional accuracy for handling payments, billing, and documentation.
Fluency in English; knowledge of Arabic or other languages is an advantage.
Professional appearance, integrity, and a customer-focused mindset.
Ability to work on-site full-time in Doha, Qatar, including weekends and retail peak hours.
Previous experience in a sales executive or similar role; vocational or diploma-level education in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred.
